Pick three tasks from your current work or studies that you perform at least once a week.

For each task, document how long it currently takes, what the pain points are, and write one paragraph on how an AI tool might augment your process.

Rubric

  • Task documentation (3 tasks described clearly): 15 pts
  • Time/pain point analysis: 15 pts
  • AI augmentation proposal: 15 pts
  • Writing quality: 5 pts
